pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit smooth, non-angular edge gradients. Morphology consists of large, vertically elongated polygons on the lower neck and smaller, more compact irregular shapes on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The interstitial light-colored pathways form a continuous network with a uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes consist of regular trivalent and tetravalent intersections, maintaining a consistent topological graph across visible regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile. The frequency of the jagged silhouette is high, although individual fiber definition is constrained by resolution limits.
